tool_note: WebSearch quota was exhausted (shared per-turn limit), so no searches were run. Evidence is from direct fetches of Cleartrip, EaseMyTrip, TripClap, Restaurant Guru, Gozocabs, HurryUp Cabs, JKTDC, SMVDSB, Wikipedia/Wikivoyage, Holidify. Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Agoda, Zomato timed out or returned empty pages. A direct curl to Gozocabs returned 403 and was dropped; Gozocabs fares come only from pages WebFetch could load. Justdial and CabBazar were not used.

stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip 3-star page, 1 night 13-14 Nov 2026, 2 guests, pre-tax discounted, all 16 listed priced: Hotel Ishan 907, Maharaja Inn 1,052, Atithi Intl 1,260, Altruist 1,334, Sanjeev Palace 1,391, Katra Avenue 1,813, Atul Regency 1,825, Amreshwar 2,041, Bali Resort Ext 2,382, Tulip Tree 3,027, Mountview 3,047, Ganpati 3,240, Devi Grand 3,685, Tree of Life 4,094, Ginger 4,157, Holiday Inn 6,099 (median of 16 = 2,211.5). Budget: Cleartrip budget page, 1 night Sun 11 - Mon 12 Oct 2026, 2 adults, pre-tax (20 of 60 listed, range 841-1,891, median 1,573.5). Dorm: Shrine Board (SMVDSB) published tariff for Katra: Shakti Bhawan, Trikuta Bhawan, Ashirwad Bhawan dorm bed 150 each, Spiritual Growth Centre AC dorm bed 200 (median 150). Tariff page carries only a post date of 9 Sep 2023 and no effective date.
stay.notes: Katra has deep OTA inventory (60 budget hotels on Cleartrip alone). Budget and mid medians are priced on different dates (11-12 Oct vs 13-14 Nov), so do not compare them as a spread. Cross-check: EaseMyTrip Katra page (no dates entered, tax extra) 3-star-rated hotels median 2,819 (n=10: Today 1,089, Katra Grand 1,515, Anurag 1,563, goSTOPS Plus 1,757, Click Sunburry 2,677, Ginger 2,961, Amritara 3,923, Bhawani Intl 3,927, Bloom 4,348, Lords Inn 4,469), about 1.3x the Cleartrip median, no 3x conflict. 5-star/branded rows run 5,400-8,229 (Marriott 6,999, Welcomhotel 8,229). Shrine Board rooms for comparison (same SMVDSB page, no effective date): Niharika Katra double AC 2,200, four-bed AC 2,800; Spiritual Growth Centre double AC 1,900, suite 3,300. JKTDC lists Yatri Niwas Katra, Hotel City Residency (TRC) and Hotel Saraswati (TB) but publishes no tariff in its page HTML (https://www.jktdc.co.in/CityHotels.aspx?Cid=4). No true homestays surfaced: Cleartrip's 'homestays in Katra' page lists hotels only (Marriott, Holiday Inn, Lemon Tree etc.). The 11-12 Oct budget snapshot may coincide with the autumn Navratri/Dussehra period, when Katra demand is high (calendar knowledge, not confirmed from a page), so it could run above a quiet-season price; no off-season comparison was measured.

taxi_day.notes: HurryUp's 8 hr / 80 km card is identical on its Katra and Patnitop pages (same fares, same per-km), so it is a chain-wide template and not a local union quote; its own 'rental table' on the Katra page shows an 8 hr row of 2,426 / 3,014 / 3,518 that does not map cleanly to vehicles, so the card values are used and 3,014 is the upper alternative for a sedan. Treat 2,432 as a floor: local unions at pilgrimage towns usually quote more. Gozocabs says 'No indicative local package fares are currently available' for Katra. Taxis are mostly used for transfers (Jammu, Patnitop, Shiv Khori); the shrine climb itself is on foot, pony, palki, battery car or helicopter, fares posted by the Shrine Board at Katra and Banganga counters (the board's palki/pony page gives no fares in text: http://www.maavaishnodevi.org/blog/palkis-ponis-pithoos).

stay.notes: Homestay figure is two points from two different sites and dates; treat as indicative only. Cleartrip's 2-star rows: Maharaja Resorts 3,079, Hotel Green Orchid 2,869 (not in the budget median as they price like mid hotels). stay.nearest_base: Kupwara town (valley entrance 9 km north of it); Handwara for Bangus side
stay.price_basis: Single point: EaseMyTrip, Guest House Chandigam (Chandigam-Sogam Rd, 12.8 km from Kupwara, listed 3-star) 4,117 per night (a second, unlabelled 4,678 also shown), +185 tax; page had blank dates and a search-error banner, so date and season unknown.
stay.notes: n=1 and undated: very low confidence; do not publish as a median. Wikipedia: 'In Lolab Valley, there are a few tourist huts and many camping sites'. Holidify: homestays available in the valley, hotels 'at least 7-10 kilometers away' (https://www.holidify.com/places/lolab-valley/). JKTDC's Lolab page lists huts but no tariff (https://www.jktdc.co.in/info.aspx?id=12). Permit: Holidify says 'Travelers may need special permits to visit certain areas in Lolab Valley' with no fee or office named; no official permit statement found. Cleartrip has no Kupwara or Lolab page (404).
